chunks: The real sovereignty will belong to Ar-Rahman. How grievous will be the day for the infidels!

key_terms.الرَّحْمَٰنِ: Ar-Rahman (The Merciful, a specific divine name)
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: On that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: Who holds true sovereignty on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the transition from relative, temporary dominion to Allah’s absolute, eternal sovereignty (Al-Mulk), highlighting that the 'hardship' for disbelievers stems from their inability to reconcile with this ultimate truth. It serves as a theological anchor for the concept of divine justice, where the weight of one's disbelief becomes insurmountable against the reality of God's mercy and power.
